target: 593 Illusi

source: 593 Fooled
target: 593 Illusi

source: In response to Gandalf’s question, Bard recounted the past with a directness that left little room for ambiguity.
target: Ad quaestionem Gandalfi respondens, Bard praeterita narravit cum directitudine quae parum spatii ad ambiguitatem reliquit.

source: “I don’t know.
target: “Nescio.

source: He didn’t tell me.
target: „Non mihi dixit.

source: After the founding of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, I began to notice the guy’s actions and demeanor mirroring the influence of the Celestial Worthy.
target: Post institutionem Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum, coepi animadvertere actus et habitum eius, qui influentiam Caelestis Digni repraesentabant.

source: Likewise, he saw the same in me, prompting a mutual inquiry.
target: Similiter, eum idem in me conspexit, quod mutuam inquisitionem excitavit.

source: Eventually, we confirmed each other’s intentions, and assembled an April Fool’s team.
target: Postremo, voluntates nostras inter nos confirmavimus et turmam “Aprilis Stultorum” congregavimus.

source: Gandalf and Hela probed about the Celestial Worthy, but with no breakthroughs, Lumian, disguised as a Muggle, shifted his gaze to Bard and asked, “What was your crew’s aim in disrupting the sea prayer ritual?”
target: Gandalf et Hela de Caelesti Digno indagaverunt, sed sine ullis inventis; Lumian, ut Muggle simulatus, aspectum suum in Bard vertit et rogavit: “Quae fuit propositum turmae tuae in perturbando ritu precationis maris?”

source: “To control the underwater spaceship.
target: “Navem spatialis subaquaticam regere.

source: It’s our ticket to traversing the cosmos and holding our ground against Angels to some extent…”
target: Est clavis nostra ad perambulandum universum et ad locum nostrum retinendum adversus Angelos, ad modicum.

source: Bard revealed April Fool’s plan.
target: Bard consilium “Aprilis Stultorum” enarravit.

source: Lumian’s lips curved upward.
target: Labia Lumiani sursum incurvata sunt.

source: “Do you know what’s sealed in the depths of that spaceship?”
target: “Scisne quid in profundis illius navis spatialis clausum sit?”

source: At this revelation, Franca suddenly grasped the core issue.
target: Ad hanc revelationem, Franca subito rem centralem intellexit.

source: Spaceship?
target: Navis spatialis?

source: The thing at the bottom of Port Santa is a spaceship?
target: Res in imo Port Santa est navis spatialis?

source: Isn’t this too sci‑fi and not mystical enough?
target: Nonne hoc nimis scientiae fictae pertinet atque non satis mysticum est?

source: Does this world have everything?
target: Habetne hic mundus omnia?

source: To expedite the interrogation of Bard, a key member of April Fool’s, Lumian and Franca had entered the Nation of the Evernight without much communication.
target: Ut interrogationi Bard, membri cardinalis “Aprilis Stultorum,” festinandum esset, Lumian et Franca in Nationem Perpetuae Noctis sine multis sermonibus intraverunt.

source: “Spaceship…” Gandalf echoed the term, his tone brimming with unmistakable yearning.
target: “Navis spatialis…” repetuit Gandalf, tono conspicuo desiderii.

source: Hela maintained a silence akin to the depths of night.
target: Hela silentium retinuit, quod simile erat profundis noctis.

source: Bard responded to Lumian’s inquiry, “According to our interpretation of the language and the insights from the Celestial Worthy, that spacecraft functions as both a petri dish and an incubation chamber.
target: Secundum nostram interpretationem linguae atque perspicientiam a Caelesti Digno, illa navis spatialis fungitur tamquam vas microbiologicum et camera incubationis.

source: It’s nurturing a high‑level creature.
target: Illud colit creaturam potentiae supremae.

source: Control the spaceship, and you control it.
target: Domina navem spatialis, et eam dominas.

source: Without that control, the spacecraft alone won’t stand a chance against an Angel.”
target: Sine ea potestate, navis spatialis sola nihil contra Angelum poterit.

source: The smile of “Aurore” became even more alluring.
target: Risus “Aurore” etiam magis alliciens factus est.

source: “Ever wondered why the ancient Angel who sealed the spaceship didn’t take control of it?
target: “Numquamne miratus es cur Angelus antiquus, qui navem spatialis clausit, eam non ceperit?

source: Why didn’t They command the high‑level creature or destroy it outright?”
target: Cur non imperaverunt creaturam potentiae supremae aut eam omnino delere?

source: Bard fell silent momentarily before articulating, “It might take a considerable time for the high‑level creature to mature.
target: Bard paulisper silentium tenuit, deinde dīcere coepit: “Creatura potentiae supremae ad maturitatem longum tempus postulat.

source: Taking control of the spaceship would halt everything.
target: Navem spatialis regere omnia sisteret.

source: Patience is required until the recent few years—just before the creature is due—before it can be managed.”
target: Patientia opus est usque ad paucos annos recentissimos—modo antequam creatura suam maturitatem adimpleat—antequam eam regere liceat.

source: Lumian’s smile beneath the hood grew brighter.
target: Risus Lumiani sub velamine clarior factus est.

source: “If that’s the case, the ancient Angel who sealed the high‑level creature will definitely reappear.
target: “Si ita est, Angelus antiquus, qui creaturam potentiae supremae clausit, certo iterum apparebit.

source: Did you have the confidence to resist an Angel and win the spaceship?
target: Num fiduciam habuisti ut Angelum resisteres atque navem spatialis obtineres?

source: Or do you believe the Angel either didn’t try to decipher or couldn’t decipher the true meaning of those commands?”
target: An putas Angelum vel non conatus esse mandata vera interpretari, vel non potuisse illas interpretari?

source: “It’s been so many years—They might have already perished…”
target: “Multos iam annos praeterierunt—fortasse iam perierunt…”

source: In his dream, a creature on the altar, potentially the avatar of an ancient Angel, hinted that the Angel might still be observing Milo Village and those waters.
target: In somnio, creatura in altare—fortasse avatar Angelus antiquus—insinuavit Angelum adhuc Milonis vicum et aquas observare.

source: “Why didn’t we think to confirm it before embarking on the entire plan…” Bard voiced his doubts, his emotions showing no apparent shifts.
target: “Cur non confirmavimus id antequam totum consilium iniremur?” dīxit Bard, dubitationes suas exprimens, cum affectūs eius nullam mutationem ostenderent.

source: Lumian replied with a smile, “I can tell you that the spaceship isn’t sealed with a high‑level creature.
target: Lumian subrisu respondit: “Tibi dicere possum: navis spatialis non est clausa cum creatura potentiae supremae.

source: It’s an incomplete, nascent black hole.
target: Est foramen nigrum inchoatum et nascens.

source: Once unsealed and piloted away, it will absorb the mystical body housing it, suck you guys in, and completely take shape, tearing apart and devouring the current world.
target: Postquam dissolutum et gubernatum erit, corpus mysticum, quod eum complectitur, absorbet, vos omnes attrahens, atque omnino formam capiet, mundum praesentem disrumpens atque devorans.

source: “Back then, the ancient Angels didn’t attempt to control it because it was dangerous, idiot!”
target: “Tum, Angeli antiqui id regere non conati sunt, quoniam periculosum erat, stulte!”

source: Bard was once again taken aback, as if he had never considered such a possibility.
target: Bard iterum miratus est, quasi talem possibilitatem numquam consideraverit.

source: After a moment, he hesitated and said, “We… might have… been fooled…”
target: Post aliquantulum, cunctatus est et dixit: “Nos forsitan decepti sumus…”

source: Though Bard’s emotions remained unchanging, the blood‑colored liquid that trickled from the simple bandage down the bridge of his nose painted a tragic and mournful picture.
target: Etsi affectūs Bardis stabile manserunt, liquidus sanguineus, qui ex simplici vinculo per nasum eius stillabat, imaginem tragicam et lugubrem depinxit.

source: Lumian burst into laughter, his back bending slightly.
target: Lumian erupit in risum, dorsum leviter flectente.

source: “Do you only now realize that you’ve all been fooled by that Celestial Worthy?
target: “Num modo nunc intellegitis vos omnes ab eo Caelesti Digno deceptos esse?

source: He provided revelations to mislead you.
target: Ipse revelationes dedit ut vos deciperet.

source: Through your deaths, He could open the seal and destroy this world to achieve His goals!
target: Per vestras mortes, potuit sigillum aperire et hunc mundum destruere ad proposita Sua assequenda!

source: “Haha, April Fool’s, indeed an organization of fools!”
target: “Haha, ‘Aprilis Stultorum’—re vera congregatio stultorum!”

source: Bard fell into silence once more, then candidly expressed his thoughts.
target: Bard iterum silentium cepit, deinde aperte cogitationes suas exprimens.

source: “We’re fools, truly fools…”
target: “Stulti sumus, vere stulti…”

source: Meanwhile, Gandalf and the others had varied reactions.
target: Interim, Gandalf et ceteri diversas responsiones habuerunt.

source: Dammit, a black hole? Destroy this world? Franca had thought the news of a spaceship was explosive enough, but she hadn’t expected something even more terrifying to follow.
target: Heu, foramen nigrum? Hunc mundum delere? Franca putavit nuntium de navis spatialis satis explosivum esse, sed aliquid adhuc terribilius sequenti non exspectaverat.

source: And an entity creating a black hole?
target: Et entitas foramen nigrum fingens?

source: Franca, lacking direct understanding of top‑level powers, realized the magnitude of such a great existence.
target: Franca, directa potentiarum summarum intellegentia carens, magnitudinem talis existentiae magni intellexit.

source: Previously, she felt she had a sufficient understanding of the world. Now, she admitted frankly, I’m still a f*cking elementary school student!
target: Prius putabat se satis mundi intellexisse; nunc, aperte agnovit: “Etiam adhuc sum discipulus rudis scholae elementariae!”

source: Gandalf took a deep breath and said, “If I become a god, it would be so convenient for me to conduct research… Black holes…”
target: Gandalf alte spiritum tulit et dīxit: “Si deus fiam, mihi valde commode erit investigare… foramina nigra…”

source: Hela retrieved a metal flask from her black widow clothes and took a sip, her thoughts inscrutable.
target: Hela ex vestimentis “viduae nigrae” lagena metallicam extraxit et sorbis cepit, cogitationes eius inenarrabiles.

source: Lumian’s laughter echoed for a moment, providing a brief respite.
target: Risu Lumiani brevi momento resonavit, levem solacium praebens.

source: However, underlying pain still gripped his heart, resonating in the shadows within.
target: Attamen, dolor subjacens adhuc cor eius premebat, in umbris interioribus resonans.

source: It couldn’t be eradicated or dismissed.
target: Nec tolli nec neglegi poterat.

source: In the presence of the key members of April Fool’s, memories of his sister Aurore’s tragic fate couldn’t be ignored.
target: In praesentia membrorum cardinalium “Aprilis Stultorum,” memoria tragoediae sororis suae Aurore neglegi non poterat.

source: Bard stood there, a silent reminder of a fact deliberately overlooked.
target: Bard ibi stetit, monefactus tacitus rei deliberanter neglectae.

source: Hence, Lumian couldn’t help but utter, “kill him and channel his spirit,” resorting to action in a half‑truth manner.
target: Itaque, Lumian non potuit non dīcere: “occide eum et spiritum eius dirige,” agendo in modo semivero.

source: Looking at Bard, Lumian inquired, “Do you know if Ultraman and Mad Lady have been to Cordu?”
target: Intuens Bard, Lumian rogavit: “Scisne utrum Ultraman et Mad Lady ad Cordu venerint?”

source: “Yes,” replied Bard.
target: “Ita,” respondit Bard.

source: Part of our original plan was to find Nolfi’s child, the sea maid.
target: Pars consilii nostri originalis fuit invenire filiam Nolfi, ancillam maris.

source: She lived in Intis’s Riston Province.
target: Illa in Provincia Riston Intis habitabat.

source: A stopover at Cordu was intended to confirm Muggle’s situation and the final outcome of the prank.
target: Statio apud Cordu destinata erat ad confirmandum statum “Muggle” et exitum finalem ioci.

source: At the mention of “prank,” a vein on Lumian’s forehead throbbed.
target: Pro mentione “ioci,” vena in fronte Lumiani pulsavit.

source: “How could you be so sure that Muggle was already dead?”
target: “Quomodo tam certus esse potuisti quod Muggle iam mortuus esset?”

source: Hearing Lumian—disguised as a Muggle—pose this question, Gandalf let out another inaudible sigh.
target: Audito Lumiani, qui ut Muggle simulabatur, hanc quaestionem posuisse, Gandalf aliud suspirium inaudibilem emisit.

source: Franca sighed inwardly.
target: Franca interioriter suspiravit.

source: Bard shook his head.
target: Bard caput concussit.

source: “I’m unsure.
target: “Nescio.

source: Mad Lady and Ultraman went.
target: Mad Lady et Ultraman profecti sunt.

source: They informed me the village was wiped out.
target: Mihi nuntiaverunt vicum omnino deletum esse.

source: No chance for anyone to make it out alive.
target: Nulla erat occasio ut quisquam vivus effugiret.

source: They might have even employed divination, spirit channeling, and such to be sure.”
target: Forsitan etiam divinationem, spiritus tractationem, et similia consilia ad certitudinem adhibuerunt.

source: “Impossible for anyone to survive?”
target: “Numquid quisquam superstes esse potest?”

source: Lumian smiled. “Am I not human?”
target: Lumian subridens dīxit: “Nonne sum humanus?”

source: Bard glanced at him and spoke his mind.
target: Bard eum intuebatur et aperte dīxit.

source: “You might not even pass as human anymore.”
target: “Forsitan iam non videaris humanus.”

source: That’s not wrong.
target: Non erras.

source: I’m now a humanoid Sealed Artifact with self‑awareness and fate…
target: Nunc ego sum artifactum sigillatum humanoide, cum conscientia et fato…

source: Lumian made a self‑deprecating remark before adding, “The number of survivors is greater than you can imagine. A certain madame, her husband, butler, and maidservant had fled.”
target: Lumian se ipsum humiliter incentivus ad eius addendum dīxit: “Numerus superstitorum maior est quam imaginari potes. Quaedam domina, maritus eius, cubicularius, et ancilla effugerunt.”

source: Without giving Bard a chance to respond, Lumian inquired further,
target: Sine Bard opportunitatem respondendi dandam, Lumian ulterius interrogavit:

source: “What was Loki trying to achieve with the Muggle incident?”
target: “Quid conari voluit Loki per rem Muggle?”

source: “I wasn’t deeply involved.
target: “Non valde implicatus eram.

source: Just tossed in a few ideas; not much in the loop,” Bard admitted honestly.
target: Modo paucas ideās conieci; nihil plurimum intererat,” sincē dīxit Bard.

source: “Ultraman might have a clue.
target: “Fortasse Ultraman aliquam indagationem habet.

source: He and Loki teamed up in other ventures.”
target: Ipse et Loki in aliis negotiis se coniunxerunt.

source: “In what ventures?” Lumian persisted.
target: “In quibus negotiis?” perseveravit Lumian.

source: Bard shook his head slowly.
target: Bard caput leviter concussit.

source: “Not entirely sure about the specifics. It’s tied to the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.”
target: “Non omnino certus sum de singularibus. Attinet ad Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Ardoris.”

source: Connected to the Eternal Blazing Sun Church? Ultraman, a Sequence 5 Priest of Light on the Sun pathway… The humanoid Sealed Artifact lost by the church on the betrothal ship… Lumian’s instincts kicked in.
target: Ad Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Ardoris coniunctum est? Ultraman, Sacerdos Ordinis Quintae Luminis in via Solari, et artifactum sigillatum humanoide, ab Ecclesia in nave nuptiali amissum, – Lumiani instinctus subito excitati sunt.

source: “Any key April Fool’s members that are not transmigrators?”
target: “Numquid sunt membri cardinales ‘Aprilis Stultorum’, qui non sint transmigratores?”

source: They had previously misconstrued April Fool’s as a gang of degenerated transmigrators.
target: Praeteritae opiniones fecerunt “Aprilis Stultorum” esse coetum transmigratorum degeneratorum.

source: Yet, as an organization, it naturally expanded.
target: Sed ut ordo, naturaliter crevit.

source: After all these years, April Fool’s likely harbored more key members!
target: Post tot annos, “Aprilis Stultorum” verisimiliter plures membra cardinalia albergabat!

source: Bard nodded.
target: Bard annuit.

source: “Yes.”
target: “Ita.”

source: As expected… Lumian shot a glance at Franca, garbed in Assassin attire, seeking confirmation from Bard.
target: Ut exspectabatur… Lumian Francam intuens, quae habitu Assassina induta erat, a Bard confirmationem quaesivit.

source: “One of them is a Purifier from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and he holds a decent status?”
target: “Unus ex illis est Purgator ab Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Ardoris, et dignum statum habet?”

source: “Yes,” Bard confirmed again.
target: “Ita,” iterum confirmavit Bard.

source: Thanks to him, we got wind of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact we could utilize when we altered our plan.
target: Eum grātiā, de Artifactō Sigillātō Grādus I nuntiati sumus, quem in nostro consiliō adhibēre poterāmus.

source: He even assisted in its escape from the seal.
target: Etiam in effugiendō id ex sigillō adiuvit.

source: “And who might this person be?” Franca inquired, stepping in for the absent 007.
target: “Et quis hic sit?” inrogavit Franca, pro absente 007 interveniens.

source: “It’s a one‑way line to Loki,” Bard indicated, revealing his lack of knowledge about the member’s true identity.
target: “Est linea unius sensus ad Loki,” Bard dēclarāvit, ignorantiam suam de vera huius membris identitāte patefaciēns.

source: Franca chuckled, saying, “If the Eternal Blazing Sun Church launches an inquiry, they might stumble upon some leads.”
target: Franca subrīsū dīxit: “Si Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Ardoris quaestionem inchoaverit, fortasse aliquam viam ad investigandum invenient.”

source: Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts weren’t just lying around. They couldn’t be pilfered casually!
target: Artifacta Sigillāta Grādus I non solum undique iacebant; neque facile furto sublabi poterant!

source: Lumian, noting Gandalf and Hela had no more queries, turned to Bard.
target: Lumian, animadvertere Gandalfum et Helam nullās alias quaestiones habēre, ad Bard conversus est.

source: “What intel do you have on Loki’s ancient castle?”
target: “Quid de castello antiquo Loki scis?”

source: “It goes by the name Dylan—a charming name,” Bard began.
target: “Dylan vocatur—nomen decora,” incepit Bard.

source: Loki once told me it’s a concealed ancient castle.
target: Loki olim mihi dīxit id esse castellum antiquum celātum.

source: Impossible to discover or see under normal circumstances.
target: In condicionibus ordinariīs detegere aut vidēre id impossibile est.

source: In simpler terms, you can’t pinpoint its location through appearance or history.
target: Verbis simplicioribus, eius locum per speciem aut historiam definīre nōn potes.

source: “I’ve always envied Loki inheriting such a treasure after transmigration—an ancient castle.
target: “Semper invidi Loki hereditātem talis thesaurī post transmigrātiōnem—castellum antiquum,

source: Later, he relied on the Celestial Worthy’s revelation and the corresponding boon to succeed.
target: deinde innititur revelationī Caelestis Dignī atque dono congruente ad efficāciam consequendam.

source: I once tried to swindle Castle Dylan for myself, but I failed.”
target: Olim conatus sum Castellum Dylan mihi fraudāre, sed defeci.
